name: Infoblox — DGA NXDOMAIN Storm (≥20 NXDOMAINs From One Client)
xql_query:
datamodel dataset = infoblox_infoblox_raw
| filter xdm.event.type = "DNS Response" and xdm.event.outcome_reason = "NXDOMAIN"
| filter xdm.source.ipv4 != null
| bin _time span = 10m
| comp count() as nxd_count by xdm.source.ipv4, _time
| filter nxd_count >= 20
| fields xdm.source.ipv4
description: ≥20 Infoblox DNS responses with outcome_reason = NXDOMAIN from one client within 10 minutes — DGA cycling indicating implant attempting many C2 candidates.
alert_name: Infoblox — DGA NXDOMAIN Storm (≥20 NXDOMAINs From One Client)

TA0011 - Command and Control: T1568.002 - Dynamic Resolution: Domain Generation Algorithms
